message:
Added a brand-new Player Stats screen so you can track your long-term progress.
Fixed a bug where Swiftness upgrades could go past the intended max level.
Fixed an issue where total playtime could reset when restarting the game or switching focus.
Improved stat saving so progress is now saved more reliably between sessions.
Added backend analytics improvements to help us better balance progression and future updates.
Tuning for Souls drop rates and Multishot balance.
